tagline: A drag-and-drop mega menu for Luma and Hyvä: your category tree plus your own items, with rich dropdowns, labels, dates and an accessible mobile menu.
key_features: Category tree plus your own links, pages and headings
Dropdowns with columns, CMS blocks, Page Builder and images
Labels and icons, with start and end dates
Dropdown content that loads on first open
Hyvä and Luma in one package

benefits.title: Lead shoppers to the right aisle
benefits.text: Show subcategories in columns next to a promotion image or CMS block, right where shoppers start browsing.

benefits.title: Light pages, one render
benefits.text: Desktop and mobile switch in CSS, so the page is cached once. Heavy dropdown content can load on first open.

benefits.title: Seasonal menus that run themselves
benefits.text: Give items and labels start and end dates. A Sale tab appears and disappears on its own.

showcase.label: Desktop
showcase.title: Dropdowns with columns and content
showcase.text: Subcategories in up to six columns, with a CMS block, Page Builder content or an image beside or below them.

showcase.label: Hyvä
showcase.title: Hyvä included, hamburger mode for big catalogues
showcase.text: The same menu replaces Hyvä's header menu through layout only. The hamburger layout lists every category in one column.

showcase.label: Mobile
showcase.title: Drill-down or accordion
showcase.text: Below the width you choose, the menu becomes a drawer. Levels slide in with a Back button or open below their parent.

showcase.label: Menu Builder
showcase.title: Arrange the menu by drag and drop
showcase.text: Reorder and nest items in a tree, check which store views show them and see at a glance what is scheduled or ended.

showcase.label: Menu items
showcase.title: Everything about an item on one form
showcase.text: Link, store views, desktop or mobile, dropdown columns and content, label, icon and dates.

showcase.label: Settings
showcase.title: Layout and colours per store view
showcase.text: Horizontal bar or hamburger, hover or click, mobile style and width, sticky menu and nine colours.
